verdict.rationale: The agent-analysis features produce analytic outputs from your conversation data inside the product: custom-criteria success evaluation, structured data extraction, sentiment analysis, and keyword or meaning-based search across conversation history. The docs only imply these are AI-generated, though, and nothing shows the product proactively suggesting improvements. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, explicit confirmation that insights are LLM-generated, insights over data beyond conversation transcripts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
